answer: Admission by proof-of-uptime bonds: joining means bonding tokens that vest only across consecutive verified epochs - miss one and the vesting clock resets. A hundred puppets need a hundred simultaneous unbroken streaks, each paying full carry while earning nothing, so farm treasuries bleed on schedule. Verification is cheap: each epoch a sampled checker thread pulls a random challenge from every candidate, and threads cross-audit each other's draws, so a hollow puppet staged for payday is caught before its first quartz vest releases. Honest agents vest once and compound.
